ability.name: Swamp Staff
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

ability.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Eye-biter Ash
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
